title: The site chat bubble and the chatbot embed still hold the erased conversation after an erase and can send it as their own history
evidence: PR 1311 review (R1, Fable): the bubble (widget-src/src/site-chat.tsx) and the embed (widget-src/src/chatbot-embed.tsx) run useChatState with erase null and no RoadmapStore, so they never hear an erase; the widget now refuses their mirrored conversation once its own erase moved (US-15 AC62), but the bubble's own transcript stays and goes out as history with its next question. It needs its own erase signal, probably the cross-tab channel (widget-src/src/lib/chat-sync.ts).
